units.source_text: 明石皇后身体非常不适，

en.t: Empress Akashi was feeling very unwell,

units.source_text: 诸皇子都来侍疾，

en.t: and all the princes came to attend her in her illness,

units.source_text: 许多公卿大夫前来问候，

en.t: while many nobles and court officials came to ask after her,

units.source_text: 殿内非常嘈杂。

en.t: so the palace was extremely noisy.

units.source_text: 但皇后并无特别重病。

en.t: But the Empress was not suffering from any especially grave illness.

units.source_text: 大内记道定是担任内务部政治的，

en.t: Dainaiki Michisada was in charge of administrative affairs in the inner offices,

units.source_text: 公事繁忙，来得较迟。

en.t: and because his official duties kept him busy, he arrived rather late.

units.source_text: 他要把宇治的回信送呈匂亲王。

en.t: He was to deliver the reply from Uji to Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 匂亲王便来到侍女值事房，

en.t: Prince Niou therefore came to the ladies-in-waiting duty room,

units.source_text: 召唤他到门口来，接受了回信。

en.t: called him over to the doorway, and received the reply.

units.source_text: 薰大将也正从里面走出来，

en.t: General Kaoru was just coming out from inside as well,

units.source_text: 瞥见匂亲王躲在侍女值事房里看信，

en.t: and he caught sight of Prince Niou hiding in the ladies-in-waiting room and reading the letter,

units.source_text: 想道：“一定是重要的情书了！”

en.t: thinking, "It must be an important love letter!"

units.source_text: 好奇心起，就站在那里窥看。

en.t: Curiosity overcame him, and he stood there peeking in.

units.source_text: 但见匂亲王展开信来阅读，

en.t: He saw Prince Niou unfold the letter and read it,

units.source_text: 信写在红色的薄纸上，非常详细。

en.t: and the letter, written on thin red paper, was very detailed.

units.source_text: 匂亲王专心看信，一时顾不得其他。

en.t: Prince Niou was absorbed in reading it and for the moment paid no attention to anything else.

units.source_text: 这时候夕雾左大臣也从里面出来，

en.t: Just then, Yugiri, the Minister of the Left, also came out from inside,

units.source_text: 将经过侍女值事房。

en.t: and was about to pass by the ladies-in-waiting duty room.

units.source_text: 薰大将便从纸隔扇门口走出来，

en.t: General Kaoru then stepped out from the paper-screen doorway,

units.source_text: 故作咳嗽，以提醒匂亲王，

en.t: and deliberately cleared his throat to warn Prince Niou,

units.source_text: 使他知道左大臣来了。

en.t: letting him know that the Minister of the Left had arrived.

units.source_text: 匂亲王立刻把信藏过。

en.t: Prince Niou immediately hid the letter away.

units.source_text: 左大臣向室中探望。

en.t: The Minister of the Left looked into the room.

units.source_text: 匂亲王惊惶失措，连忙整理袍上的衣带。

en.t: Prince Niou, flustered and at a loss, hurriedly straightened the sash on his robe.

units.source_text: 左大臣就在那里屈膝坐下，

en.t: The Minister of the Left bent his knees and sat down there,

units.source_text: 对他说道：“我要回去了。

en.t: and said to him, "I am going home now.

units.source_text: 皇后这老毛病虽然长久不发了，

en.t: Although this old ailment of the Empress has not appeared for a long time,

units.source_text: 但很可担心。

en.t: it is still very worrying.

units.source_text: 你立刻派人去招请比叡山的住持僧来吧。”

en.t: Send someone at once to invite the abbot of Mount Hiei here."

units.source_text: 说罢匆忙地向别处去了。

en.t: After saying this, he hurried off elsewhere.

units.source_text: 到了夜深时分，大家从皇后御前退出。

en.t: Late that night, everyone withdrew from the Empress's presence.

units.source_text: 左大臣叫匂亲王当先，

en.t: The Minister of the Left had Prince Niou go first,

units.source_text: 带了许多皇子、公卿大夫、殿上人等，

en.t: and, taking many princes, nobles, court officials, and courtiers with him,

units.source_text: 一同赴自邸去。

en.t: they all went together to his own residence.
